description: Send ONE real email from one of the workspace's verified addresses. This delivers actual mail to the recipient, so confirm the content with the user before calling. For a LIST of recipients, do NOT loop this tool: use import_contacts + create_campaign instead. Campaigns add per-recipient unsubscribe links, honor the suppression list, and pace delivery to protect sender reputation; looping one-off sends is refused after a few distinct recipients per hour. Counts against the plan's monthly send quota. If `from` is omitted, the workspace's primary (oldest active, verified) address is used. On failure returns { error, message } instead of throwing.

from.description: Sender address on a verified domain the workspace owns, e.g. hello@yourdomain.com

name: send_email
